node.title: H3 quotient multiplicities are coefficient-coset block sizes minus one
node.statement: For A=(1-H)\{0} and nonidentity t, set u(t)=1/(1-t), v(t)=-t/(1-t), and partition F_p\{0,1} by the HxH coefficient coset (u(t)H,v(t)H). If B is a block and t is in B, then the quotient multiplicity R(t)=#{(c,d) in A^2:d/c=t} equals |B|-1 and is constant on B. Consequently sum_B |B|(|B|-1)=(n-1)(n-2). Proof: coefficient points in a block are (u(t)h,v(t)k) on U+V=1; (h,k)=(1,1) is the unique zero/zero excluded pair, and every other point is exactly one valid shifted quotient representation. This is the exact quotient collision ledger consumed by the weighted C36' attack.
